title: Project Atom in Serpo matches TTSA's Atom project

tellings.quote: And Project Atom is a um Los Alamos uh secret program that studies nuclear radiation and the radiation properties of materials recovered from extraterrestrial or alien spacecraft.

plain: Project Serpo, a story about a supposed secret exchange between the US and aliens, includes a "Project Atom", which the researcher Deep Prasad describes as a secret Los Alamos programme that studied the radiation from materials recovered from alien spacecraft. Prasad tells Michels that this matches an Atom project at To The Stars Academy, a company formed by the musician Tom DeLonge with the physicist Hal Puthoff, active around 2013 to 2016, though he gives no source beyond the Serpo story. If true, it would suggest the company was echoing, or connected to, a real hidden programme.
